Hi there! To update the legal name that appears on your invoices, go to **Settings → Billing → Company details** and edit the legal name there. The change will be applied to all invoices generated after you save the update.

Please note that we don’t re‑issue invoices that have already been created – the corrected name will only show on future invoices. If you need a corrected copy of a past invoice for your records, just let us know and we can provide one through support.
